patch_description: This proposal performs a crossover combining the compact, symmetry-aware parameter sharing from the better-performing compact designs with a targeted, parameter-efficient entangling motif inspired by the more expressive CRX/CRY mixtures. The new ANSATZ_SPEC keeps the number of unique parameters per block low (9), which yields N_PARAMS = 9 * N_UPLOADS * N_REPEATS = 54 — matching the successful compact candidate — while adding sparse parametrized two-qubit rotations: CRY on a reduced set of ring edges (four alternating ring links) and CRX on the four spokes to the hub. This trades off some entangling density for lower depth and gate count while preserving axis-mixing complementary to the RX feature map. Single-qubit layers are symmetry-shared between corners, edges, and center to capture board structure while remaining parameter-efficient. The block order (initial RY, a shared RZ pre-phase, sparse CRY/CRX entangling, RX mixing, and a compact final RY) keeps circuits shallow and expressive for better generalization with fewer parameters.
